verdict.rationale: Zapier's own docs show in-product AI-generated suggestions in one narrow area: AI-written troubleshooting instructions for failed Zap workflows, which the user reviews. Zapier Agents can also "connect to your business data," but the evidence frames them as task-performing, not insight-generating. Missing for 10: general AI insights or analysis over the user's own app data, proactive suggestions beyond error troubleshooting, depth documentation on the troubleshooting feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Zapier will use AI to create troubleshooting instructions for you to review.
Create specialized agents—with the help of Zapier Copilot—to connect to your business data and perform tasks across 9,000+ apps.
